stories.headline: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent order $35B+ of export-compliant Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 cards

key_facts.fact: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered more than 3 million of Nvidia's new RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards with a collective sticker price of over $35 billion, according to two people familiar with the matter cited by Reuters on Oct 20.
key_facts.excerpt: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered more than 3 million of Nvidia's new RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards with a collective sticker price of over $35 billion, two people familiar with the matter said, in a rush for a less powerful but export-compliant chip amid US restrictions on trade with China.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia told customers and partners it cannot guarantee it can fill the orders; one source said partners might receive only 5% to 10% of quantities requested, and another said Nvidia could produce no more than 3 million RTX PRO 5500 cards globally in 2027. Total orders from China exceeded 6 million.
key_facts.excerpt: One source said Nvidia told partners they might receive only 5% to 10% of the quantities requested. Another said the company had indicated it could produce no more than 3 million RTX PRO 5500 cards globally in 2027. Total orders from customers in China have exceeded 6 million, two of the sources said.

key_facts.fact: The cards are priced at about $11,400 each; the RTX PRO 5500 is a workstation chip, less powerful than the H200 and B300, and Chinese buyers want it mainly for AI inference.
key_facts.excerpt: The three Chinese tech giants' orders are for cards priced at about $11,400 each... Chinese companies are seeking to use the cards primarily for AI inference

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's Blackwell-based B300 cannot be sold to Chinese buyers under US export controls, while H200 exports are reviewed case by case and subject to licensing conditions.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia's Blackwell-based B300 data-centre chip is not allowed to be sold to Chinese buyers under US export controls, while exports of its Hopper-based H200 are reviewed on a case-by-case basis and are subject to licensing conditions.

key_facts.fact: Starting in 2027 Nvidia is expected to devote much of its TSMC capacity to its Rubin data-center platform; customers were told to expect early RTX PRO 5500 samples in December and commercial deliveries from Q1 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Starting in 2027, Nvidia is expected to devote much of its capacity at Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co to Rubin... Nvidia has told customers to expect early samples in December, with commercial deliveries beginning in the first quarter of 2027

key_facts.fact: An Nvidia spokesperson blamed 'outdated US export controls, which cover gaming products released nearly a half a decade ago, and China's own limit on US imports' for restricting US firms.
key_facts.excerpt: "US firms continue to be restricted by a combination of outdated US export controls, which cover gaming products released nearly a half a decade ago, and China's own limit on US imports," the spokesperson said.

stories.headline: Nscale in talks for second ~$45B compute deal with Anthropic at West Virginia campus

key_facts.fact: Nscale is in talks to sell Anthropic computing power in a deal worth about $45 billion, Bloomberg reported on Oct 19, citing people familiar with the negotiations; a deal could be finalized within days but terms could change.
key_facts.excerpt: Nscale is in talks to secure a computing deal worth about $45 billion with Anthropic, Bloomberg News reported... A deal could be finalized within days, although discussions remain ongoing and terms could change.

key_facts.fact: The deal would cover a second building at Nscale's Monarch campus in West Virginia, delivering 460 MW of capacity on Nvidia Vera Rubin chips; Anthropic would also get a right of first refusal on a third building.
key_facts.excerpt: The proposed agreement would cover a second building at Nscale's Monarch data center campus in West Virginia, delivering 460 megawatts of computing capacity powered by Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin AI chips... The Claude developer also has a right of first refusal on the campus's anticipated third building

key_facts.fact: Anthropic already has infrastructure agreements with Nscale worth as much as $44.6 billion per Nscale's IPO filing; the first deal, signed in August, is a six-year, 460 MW lease at the same campus with delivery from late 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The first contract, signed in August, is a six-year, $45 billion, 460 MW lease at the same campus, with delivery beginning in late 2027.

key_facts.fact: Nscale is seeking a roughly $30 billion valuation in its planned IPO; some investors have told bankers $16 billion to $19 billion would draw more buyers.
key_facts.excerpt: Investors are pushing back on a roughly $30 billion valuation target, with some telling bankers that $16 billion to $19 billion would draw more buyers.

key_facts.fact: Nscale reported a net loss of $1 billion on revenue of $141 million in the first half of 2026, and its September prospectus disclosed no binding commitments for the funding needed to build the first Anthropic site.
key_facts.excerpt: It reported a net loss of $1 billion on revenue of $141 million in the first half of 2026... Its September IPO prospectus disclosed that it had no binding commitments for the funding required to construct the site at that point.

key_facts.fact: Under the arrangement Anthropic would buy computing capacity rather than lease the facility; Nscale would own and operate the data center and chips.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic would purchase computing capacity rather than lease the data centre itself. Under this arrangement, Nscale would own and operate the facility and its chips

stories.headline: Korean neocloud Elice sinks 33% in Kosdaq debut, worst for a $100M+ Korean IPO

key_facts.fact: Elice closed its Oct 20 Kosdaq debut at 60,500 won, down 33.15% from its 90,500-won IPO price, after falling as low as 56,500 won during the session.
key_facts.excerpt: Elice, which went public on the 20th, closed trading on the KOSDAQ market at 60,500 won, down 33.15% from its initial public offering (IPO) price of 90,500 won. During the session, the stock fell as low as 56,500 won.

key_facts.fact: The IPO raised 201 billion won ($151 million), priced at the top of the range, with the retail tranche 400 times subscribed; it was the biggest Kosdaq IPO of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: the company raised 201 billion won (US$151 million) in an initial public offering priced at the top of the marketed range, with the retail tranche 400 times subscribed... Elice's IPO was the biggest on the Kosdaq in 2026

key_facts.fact: Per Bloomberg data, it is the worst first-day performance on record for a Korean IPO that raised at least $100 million, surpassing W-Scope Chungju Plant's 30% drop in 2022.
key_facts.excerpt: if the 33 per cent drop holds, it would become the worst-ever debut after a Korea IPO that raised at least US$100 million, surpassing the 30 per cent plunge by W-Scope Chungju Plant in 2022.

key_facts.fact: Founded in 2015 by three KAIST doctoral students as a coding-education platform, Elice pivoted to AI cloud infrastructure and built a modular data-center platform with high-density power and liquid cooling; first-half revenue rose 200% to 34.4 billion won.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in 2015 by three students in the doctorate program of Kaist... Elice began as a coding education platform before pivoting to AI cloud infrastructure... Elice touted a 200 per cent surge in first-half revenue to 34.4 billion won

key_facts.fact: The IPO valued Elice at roughly $755 million; the KOSPI fell almost 4% to 5,552 the same day, with SK Hynix down about 4%.
key_facts.excerpt: Elice raised $151 million in its initial public offering at a valuation of roughly $755 million... The benchmark KOSPI index dropped almost 4% to finish at 5,552, weighed down by losses of around 3% for Samsung Electronics and roughly 4% for memory chipmaker SK Hynix.

key_facts.fact: Reuters likened South Korea's market to a 'canary in a coal mine' for the AI investment boom; Bloomberg noted Australia's Permagrid withdrew its IPO and AirTrunk is postponing its listing.
key_facts.excerpt: Reuters highlighted Ellis's plunge and likened the South Korean stock market to a "canary in a coal mine."... Australia's Permagrid withdrew its planned IPO due to concerns over its valuation. Data center operator AirTrunk is postponing its listing plans

stories.headline: Eka Robotics raises $150M Series A at $1.45B for force-sensing robot manipulation

key_facts.fact: Eka Robotics closed a $150 million Series A at a $1.45 billion post-money valuation, co-led by a16z and F-Prime, announced Oct 20.
key_facts.excerpt: the startup just closed an $150 million Series A round that values it at $1.45 billion post-money, led by venture funds a16z and F-Prime.

key_facts.fact: Eka was founded by MIT professor Pulkit Agrawal and former Google DeepMind researcher Tuomas Haarnoja.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded by MIT professor Pulkit Agrawal and former Google DeepMind researcher Tuomas Haarnoja

key_facts.fact: Instead of a vision-language-action model, Eka uses a 'vision-force-action' model paired with a force-sensitive gripper, trained via reinforcement learning in physics simulation rather than human demonstration data.
key_facts.excerpt: Rather than a vision-language-action model... the schema here is a vision-force-action model... it comes down to using a physics simulator to model the multiple forces the robot will encounter

key_facts.fact: The robot can pick about 1,500 objects weighing up to 1 kg per hour, versus about 600 for a human, with more than 95% reliability, according to the company.
key_facts.excerpt: It can pick up about 1,500 objects that weigh up to 1 kg in an hour, compared to about 600 for a human; Eka says it reliably picks up objects more than 95% of the time.

key_facts.fact: Eka's gripper costs less than $1,000 and is rated for 5 million duty cycles, short of the 20 million set by standard industrial arms; it is running pilots with industrial customers in pick-and-place and wire handling.
key_facts.excerpt: Eka's gripper hardware — which costs less than $1,000 — is rated for 5 million duty cycles, but the ultimate goal is to hit the 20 million cycle bar set by standard industrial arms.

stories.headline: DeepSeek co-designing Huawei AI chips, plans Ascend 950DT pre-training by end-2026

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek is working closely with Huawei to shape the design of future AI chips, two people familiar with the matter told The Information on Oct 19.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek is working closely with Huawei Technologies to shape the design of future AI chips, two people familiar with the matter said, in a collaboration that could help China build frontier AI models without Nvidia's technology.

key_facts.fact: Huawei engineers are stationed at DeepSeek's offices, incorporating its feedback into chip designs, including how models perform calculations and move data between processors.
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei engineers have been stationed at DeepSeek's offices, incorporating its feedback into chip designs, including how AI models perform calculations and transfer data between processors

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek plans to begin training on Huawei's Ascend 950DT as soon as end-2026, and Huawei plans to prioritize DeepSeek for most of its next-generation Ascend 960DT chips, expected in Q1 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek plans to begin using Huawei's Ascend 950DT chips for model training as soon as the end of 2026. Huawei also plans to prioritize DeepSeek for most of its next-generation Ascend 960DT chips, expected in the first quarter of 2027.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's B300 delivers roughly seven times the raw arithmetic performance of Huawei's Ascend 950, per Epoch AI; training a frontier model could require more than 10,000 Huawei chips running together for weeks.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia's B300 chips deliver roughly seven times the raw arithmetic performance of Huawei's Ascend 950 processors, according to research institute Epoch AI. Training a frontier model could require more than 10,000 Huawei chips operating together for weeks

key_facts.fact: Huawei plans to launch the 950DT in Q4 2026 with 144GB of its own HiZQ 2.0 HBM and 4 TB/s of memory bandwidth.
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei plans to launch the 950DT in the fourth quarter of 2026 with 144GB of its own HiZQ 2.0 HBM and 4 TB/s of memory bandwidth

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek is not abandoning Nvidia and continues to seek access to its advanced processors; it also uses TileLang, an open-source language that eases porting across chip architectures, released for Ascend 950 last month.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek is also using TileLang, an open-source programming language that can help developers adapt AI software across chip architectures... DeepSeek is not abandoning Nvidia and continues to seek access to its advanced processors

stories.headline: Meta details Prometheus, its Ohio supercluster headed to ~1M GPUs, with reliability data

key_facts.fact: In an engineering post on Oct 19, Meta said the first phase of Prometheus, its gigawatt-scale supercluster in New Albany, Ohio, is complete and trained the Muse family of models, including Muse Wonder.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta has published a detailed look at Prometheus, its gigawatt-scale AI supercluster in New Albany, Ohio. The first phase is complete and was used to train the Muse family of foundation models, including the Muse Wonder frontier models.

key_facts.fact: Prometheus today spans hundreds of thousands of GPUs across multiple buildings, including rapid-deployment structures and leased capacity, and will reach roughly 1 million GPUs at full scale.
key_facts.excerpt: Prometheus spans "hundreds of thousands of GPUs" across several buildings... At full scale it will hold "roughly 1 million distributed GPUs, all functioning in lockstep".

key_facts.fact: The cluster runs Nvidia GB200 NVL72 (Catalina) and GB300 NVL72 (Clemente) racks, with Vera Rubin NVL72 (San Miguel) racks of over 170 kW, fully liquid-cooled, arriving next; each 72-GPU rack trains on 64 GPUs and keeps 8 as spares.
key_facts.excerpt: Prometheus runs two NVIDIA platforms: Catalina, built on GB200 NVL72... and Clemente, built on GB300 NVL72... A third, San Miguel, based on NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 with fully liquid-cooled racks of over 170 kW, is arriving next. Each 72-GPU domain trains on a 64-GPU slice and keeps eight GPUs as in-rack spares

key_facts.fact: Interruptions peaked at nearly 1,000 a day per 8,000 GPUs when the cluster came online in mid-2025; a year of work cut that by 99%, and Muse Wonder pre-training ran above 85% goodput with ~47,000 GPU hours between interruptions, since raised above 54,000.
key_facts.excerpt: When Prometheus first came online in mid-2025, Meta says interruptions peaked at nearly 1,000 a day for every 8,000 GPUs. A year of work... cut that by 99%... more than 85% "goodput" for pre-training... about 47,000 GPU hours between interruptions, since raised to over 54,000.

key_facts.fact: Synchronized GPU workloads cause 30-40% power swings; Meta manages them with software called Dynamo Dimmer plus rack batteries and site-level storage.
key_facts.excerpt: Prometheus produces power swings of 30% to 40%... Meta handles this with software called Dynamo Dimmer, which gradually lowers GPU power limits as the cluster nears its electrical ceiling... backed by rack batteries, capacitor trays and site-level battery storage.

key_facts.fact: Prometheus is the blueprint for Hyperion, Meta's next supercluster in Richland Parish, Louisiana, designed with closed-loop liquid cooling and a full grid connection through Entergy paid for by Meta.
key_facts.excerpt: Prometheus is the blueprint for Hyperion, Meta's next supercluster in Richland Parish, Louisiana, which is being designed with closed-loop liquid cooling and a full grid connection through utility Entergy, paid for by Meta.

stories.headline: Amazon pledges €16B+ in Germany for 2027, including €4.8B for AWS data centers

key_facts.fact: Amazon said on Oct 20 at the federal government's Invest in Germany Summit in Berlin that it plans to invest more than €16 billion in Germany in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon plans to invest more than 16 billion euros in Germany in 2027... The company made this announcement on Tuesday at the "Invest in Germany Summit", held by the Federal Government in Berlin.

key_facts.fact: Of the total, €4.8 billion is planned in 2027 to expand the AWS Europe (Frankfurt) Region for cloud and AI services.
key_facts.excerpt: the company plans to invest 4.8 billion euros in 2027 to expand its AWS Europe (Frankfurt) Region, continuing to meet customer demand for advanced cloud and AI services.

key_facts.fact: Amazon is opening a second robotics and AI research lab in Berlin, doubling its research presence there, hiring robotics hardware, software and systems engineers.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon is currently opening a second research lab for robotics and artificial intelligence in Berlin, doubling its research presence in the capital... including Applied Scientists, Robotics Hardware Engineers, Robotics Software Engineers, and Robotics Systems Engineers.

key_facts.fact: The package also covers Amazon Leo satellite internet, logistics expansion and new Prime Video productions; Amazon says it has invested over €100 billion in Germany since 2010.
key_facts.excerpt: These include the expansion of data centers and AI infrastructure, high-speed satellite internet through Amazon Leo, new logistics projects across the country, and a major new production slate by Prime Video... since 2010, Amazon has invested over €100 billion in Germany

key_facts.fact: Economy minister Katherina Reiche called the investment 'a clear vote of confidence in Germany', saying high-performance data centers are 'the foundation of the digital economy'.
key_facts.excerpt: "Amazon's investment is a clear vote of confidence in Germany as a location for the future. High-performance data centers are the foundation of the digital economy."

key_facts.fact: Amazon has not disclosed the cost of the new Berlin robotics lab.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon is also opening a second robotics and AI research lab in Berlin, doubling its research presence in the city, but it has not disclosed the cost of the new facility.
